updates.title: Microsoft Purview Data Loss Prevention: Integration with Microsoft Entra Global Secure Access (General Availability)
updates.summary: Microsoft Purview DLP now integrates with Microsoft Entra Global Secure Access to enforce data protection policies at the network layer across browsers, apps, APIs, and AI platforms. Admins can now detect risky user activity and prevent sensitive data sharing with untrusted cloud applications using a single policy framework.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview Data Loss Prevention: Expanded Inline Protection for Unmanaged Apps in Edge for Business
updates.summary: Admins can now use existing Purview DLP policies to protect sensitive data shared through a significantly broader set of unmanaged generative AI and third-party apps in Edge for Business via browser inline protection. This extends consistent data security controls to more destinations without requiring separate policy frameworks.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview Data Loss Prevention: Upgraded Inline Protection for Microsoft Entra-Managed Apps in Edge for Business
updates.summary: Microsoft Purview inline data protection for Entra-managed apps in Edge for Business now integrates with Conditional Access grant controls, enabling admins to use expanded conditions, multiple activities per rule, simulation mode, and configurable alerts. This simplification removes previous policy restrictions while maintaining audit visibility.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview Data Loss Prevention: User-Based Aggregation of DLP Alerts
updates.summary: DLP alerts can now be aggregated by user entity even when multiple rules are matched, consolidating related alert events into a single alert object. This reduces alert noise, simplifies investigation workflows, and improves contextual understanding of violations for admins managing high-volume alert environments.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview Data Loss Prevention: Unmanaged Cloud App Discovery with Island Enterprise Browser
updates.summary: Microsoft Purview DLP now integrates with Island Enterprise Browser to detect and protect data shared with unmanaged cloud apps through browser workflows using existing Purview classifiers and sensitivity labels. This extends protection to HTTP/HTTPS traffic across Island's browser add-ins and extensions.

updates.title: Endpoint Data Loss Prevention: Pre-Curated File Extension List for Policy Conditions
updates.summary: Endpoint DLP now provides a pre-curated list of supported file extensions for policy conditions, eliminating free-form text entry and preventing unsupported extensions from being used. This improves policy reliability, reduces endpoint processing overhead, and closes protection gaps caused by invalid file type specifications.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview Data Lifecycle Management: Archive SharePoint Files Under Retention Policies
updates.summary: Admins can now configure retention policies in Microsoft Purview to archive (not just retain or delete) inactive SharePoint files to low-cost storage while keeping content discoverable. This extends lifecycle management capabilities and reduces storage costs without compromising compliance or AI-driven search results.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview Data Lifecycle Management: Automated Cleanup of Departed Users' OneDrives and Mailboxes
updates.summary: Admins can now configure data lifecycle policies to automatically delete both content and containers for departed employees at scale, ensuring regulatory compliance without manual intervention. This reduces the administrative burden of managing inactive user resources while maintaining audit trails.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview eDiscovery: In-Product Diagnostics for Troubleshooting
updates.summary: eDiscovery now includes self-service in-product diagnostics to identify common configuration issues with case permissions, security filters, and policy status, along with guidance to resolve them. This helps eDiscovery admins independently troubleshoot problems and reduces dependency on support escalations.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Unified Classification Management Experience
updates.summary: Admins now have a single interface to discover, create, validate, and manage all classifiers in Purview—Sensitive Information Types, Exact Data Match, fingerprint SITs, and trainable classifiers. This consolidation simplifies policy configuration and reduces the complexity of managing multiple classification frameworks.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview Data Lifecycle Management: Insights and Recommendations on Sensitive M365 Data
updates.summary: Purview now provides admins with insights on sensitive data in OneDrive and SharePoint, along with policy recommendations for governing retention and lifecycle management of that data. These actionable recommendations help admins improve their security and compliance posture based on actual tenant data patterns.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview Data Lifecycle Management: Legacy Teams Retention Policies No Longer Apply to Copilot
updates.summary: Existing retention policies scoped to Microsoft Teams will be converted to Teams-only policies and will no longer implicitly govern Microsoft 365 Copilot interactions. Admins must create separate policies if they want to govern Copilot workload retention, preventing unintended data governance scope creep.

updates.title: CVE-2026-77903: Microsoft Dataverse Authentication Bypass Vulnerability
updates.summary: An authentication bypass vulnerability via spoofing in Microsoft Dataverse allows unauthorized attackers to elevate privileges over a network. Admins should apply the security update immediately to prevent potential unauthorized access to Dataverse resources.

updates.title: CVE-2026-85889: Azure AI Foundry Missing Authentication Vulnerability
updates.summary: Missing authentication for a critical function in Azure AI Foundry enables unauthorized attackers to elevate privileges over a network. This authentication bypass poses a significant risk to organizations using Azure AI Foundry and requires immediate patching.

updates.title: CVE-2026-69843: Microsoft Fabric Authentication Bypass Vulnerability
updates.summary: An authentication bypass via spoofing in Microsoft Fabric allows unauthorized attackers to elevate privileges over a network. Admins should prioritize patching this vulnerability to protect Fabric environments from unauthorized access.

updates.title: CVE-2026-69865: Microsoft Container Registry Elevation of Privilege Vulnerability
updates.summary: An authorization bypass in Microsoft Container Registry through user-controlled keys allows unauthorized attackers to elevate privileges over a network. Admins using Container Registry should apply updates to prevent unauthorized access to container resources.

updates.title: CVE-2026-68791: Azure Machine Learning Information Disclosure Vulnerability
updates.summary: Incorrect authorization in Azure Machine Learning allows unauthorized attackers to disclose sensitive information over a network. Admins should review access controls and apply security updates to prevent unintended data exposure.

updates.title: CVE-2026-85878: Azure Database for PostgreSQL Privilege Escalation Vulnerability
updates.summary: Improper authorization in Azure Database for PostgreSQL allows authorized attackers to escalate privileges over a network. Admins should review role assignments and access policies, then apply the security patch to prevent unauthorized privilege escalation.
